name: Chime Ball Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chime Ball Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, is a Taiwanese firm specializing in the design, production, and marketing of advanced exposure equipment for printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its core product portfolio includes energy-efficient LED exposure systems, specifically UV-LED machines for solder-resistant, outer layer, and inner layer applications. The company also offers state-of-the-art digital direct imaging (DDI) exposure machines, leveraging both laser and UV-LED light sources. Complementing these are solder mask exposure machines, fully automated laminating systems, a range of exposure lamps, and UV energy illuminance meters. In addition to its primary PCB equipment business, Chime Ball provides comprehensive plant equipment transfer solutions, encompassing sales, installation, and maintenance services for semiconductor process equipment refurbishment and spare parts. Further expanding its operations, the company distributes various mechanical equipment and electronic components, offers data software services, engages in global trade, and serves as an investment advisor. Founded in 1988, Chime Ball Technology Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
